q-2389.solution:
Let $u={x}^{3}+@@B@@.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=3{x}^{2}\,⟹\,\frac{1}{3}\text{d}u={x}^{2}\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{3{x}^{2}}{\sqrt{{x}^{3}+@@B@@}}\,\text{d}x & =3\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{{x}^{3}+@@B@@}}\cdot {x}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & =3\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\cdot \frac{1}{3}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{3}{3}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =2\sqrt{u}+C \\  & =2\sqrt{{x}^{3}+@@B@@}+C\end{aligned}
$$

q-113726.solution:
Let $u=@@B@@-{x}^{5}.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=-5{x}^{4}\,⟹\,-\frac{7}{5}\text{d}u=7{x}^{4}\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{7{x}^{4}}{{(@@B@@-{x}^{5})}^{6}}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{{(@@B@@-{x}^{5})}^{6}}\cdot 7{x}^{4}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{1}{{u}^{6}}\cdot (-\frac{7}{5})\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{7}{5}\int \frac{1}{{u}^{6}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{7}{5}(-\frac{1}{5{u}^{5}})+C \\  & =\frac{7}{25{u}^{5}}+C \\  & =\frac{7}{25(@@B@@-{x}^{5})^{5}}+C\end{aligned}
$$

q-113728.solution:
Let $u=@@B@@-{x}^{3}.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=-3{x}^{2}\,⟹\,(-\frac{2}{3})\text{d}u=2{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{2{x}^{2}}{\sqrt{@@B@@-{x}^{3}}}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{@@B@@-{x}^{3}}}\cdot 2{x}^{2}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\cdot (-\frac{2}{3})\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{2}{3}(2\sqrt{u})+C \\  & =-\frac{4}{3}\sqrt{u}+C \\  & =-\frac{4}{3}\sqrt{@@B@@-{x}^{3}}+C\end{aligned}
$$

q-12502.solution:
Let $u={x}^{2}+@@B@@.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=2x\,⟹\,\frac{1}{2}\text{d}u=x\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{x}{{({x}^{2}+@@B@@)}^{10}}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{{({x}^{2}+@@B@@)}^{10}}\cdot x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{1}{{u}^{10}}\cdot \frac{1}{2}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{1}{{u}^{10}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(-\frac{1}{9{u}^{9}})+C \\  & =-\frac{1}{18{u}^{9}}+C \\  & =-\frac{1}{18({x}^{2}+@@B@@)^{9}}+C\end{aligned}
$$

q-49560.solution:
Let $u={s}^{5}+@@B@@.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}s}=5{s}^{4}\,⟹\,\frac{1}{5}\text{d}u={s}^{4}\,\text{d}s,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{10{s}^{4}}{\sqrt{{s}^{5}+@@B@@}}\,\text{d}s & =10\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{{s}^{5}+@@B@@}}\cdot {s}^{4}\,\text{d}s \\  & =10\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\cdot \frac{1}{5}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{10}{5}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =2\cdot (2\sqrt{u})+C \\  & =4\sqrt{u}+C \\  & =4\sqrt{{s}^{5}+@@B@@}+C\end{aligned}
$$

q-49561.solution:
Let $u=@@B@@-{y}^{4}.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}y}=-4{y}^{3}\,⟹\,(-\frac{1}{4})\text{d}u={y}^{3}\,\text{d}y,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{4{y}^{3}}{{(@@B@@-{y}^{4})}^{5}}\,\text{d}y & =4\int \frac{1}{{(@@B@@-{y}^{4})}^{5}}\cdot {y}^{3}\,\text{d}y \\  & =4\int \frac{1}{{u}^{5}}\cdot (-\frac{1}{4})\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{4}{4}\int \frac{1}{{u}^{5}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\int \frac{1}{{u}^{5}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-(-\frac{1}{4{u}^{4}})+C \\  & =\frac{1}{4{u}^{4}}+C \\  & =\frac{1}{4{(@@B@@-{y}^{4})}^{4}}+C\end{aligned}
$$

q-49575.solution:
Let $u=@@B@@-{x}^{2}.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=-2x\,⟹\,(-\frac{1}{2})\text{d}u=x\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{x}{{(@@B@@-{x}^{2})}^{5}}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{{(@@B@@-{x}^{2})}^{5}}\cdot x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{1}{{u}^{5}}\cdot (-\frac{1}{2})\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{1}{{u}^{5}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{1}{2}(-\frac{1}{4{u}^{4}})+C \\  & =\frac{1}{8{u}^{4}}+C \\  & =\frac{1}{8(@@B@@-{x}^{2})^{4}}+C\end{aligned}
$$

q-49634.solution:
Let $u={x}^{2}+@@B@@.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=2x\,⟹\,\frac{1}{2}\text{d}u=x\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{3x}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+@@B@@}}\,\text{d}x & =3\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{{x}^{2}+@@B@@}}\cdot x\,\text{d}x \\  & =3\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\cdot \frac{1}{2}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{3}{2}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{3}{2}(2\sqrt{u})+C \\  & =3\sqrt{u}+C \\  & =3\sqrt{{x}^{2}+@@B@@}+C\end{aligned}
$$

q-113727.solution:
Let $u=@@B@@-{x}^{6}.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=-6{x}^{5}\,⟹\,(-\frac{1}{6})\text{d}u={x}^{5}\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{{x}^{5}}{\sqrt{@@B@@-{x}^{6}}}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{@@B@@-{x}^{6}}}\cdot {x}^{5}\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\cdot (-\frac{1}{6})\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{1}{6}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{u}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =-\frac{1}{6}(2\sqrt{u})+C \\  & =-\frac{1}{3}\sqrt{u}+C \\  & =-\frac{1}{3}\sqrt{@@B@@-{x}^{6}}+C\end{aligned}
